description: Validate a project's conformetry instances against their templates.

configurationPath.description: Path to the conformetry configuration file, relative to the workspace root.

languages.description: Language names to restrict the run to. Every language runs when omitted.

threshold.description: Lowest conformance score an instance may have, from 0 to 1. Overridden by a generator's own threshold and by an instance group's.

title: Conformetry validate
